events.title: Galentine’s Day Floral Workshop with Meregold Creations
events.description: Join us at The Mockingbird for a relaxed, creative Galentine’s Day celebration featuring Meredith of Meregold Creations. Guests will enjoy a guided floral workshop with all supplies and instruction provided. Doors open at 11:00 AM so you can settle in, enjoy food and drinks, and sip mimosas before crafting begins at 12:00 PM. Food and drinks will be available for purchase throughout the event.

events.title: Valentine’s Dinner for Two.
events.description:
Celebrate love this Valentine’s Day with an elegant, ticketed dining experience at The Mockingbird on Mill Road. Enjoy a romantic evening featuring live music by the Aaron & Peter String Duo, creating a warm and intimate atmosphere throughout the night.

Each ticket includes a five-course French-inspired dinner, a bottle of wine to share, and a keepsake 8×10 professional photo of you and your Valentine.

Perfect for date night, anniversaries, or simply celebrating love.

Valentine’s Day Menu
• Warm Brie & Fig Crostini
• Salade Parisienne with Dijon Vinaigrette
• Classic French Onion Soup
• Beef Bourguignon with Creamy Mashed Potatoes
• Blueberry Clafoutis

Menu subject to minor changes. Dietary accommodations available with advance notice.
